title: Cross-Stack Standard fixture
description: fixture.json in a fail-then-pass fixture directory: test/fixtures/<track>/clean/, test/fixtures/<track>/clean-overlays/<RULE-ID>/ or test/fixtures/<track>/violations/<RULE-ID>/. Every other file in the directory is copied onto the harness host. alsoFires and expect are only valid in a violation fixture.

description.description: Reviewer note: what the fixture shows and why it violates or satisfies the rule.

hosts.description: Harness hosts (test/harness/<name>/) the fixture runs on. A violation fixture runs once per host; clean layers must list every host their rules use.

manifestOverlay.description: JSON Merge Patch (RFC 7396) applied to .cross-stack/standard.json in the work directory after this layer's files (the file is created when missing).

base.description: Directory inside the fixture committed as the base commit. Needs a host with git.

head.description: Directory inside the fixture committed as the head commit. Needs a host with git.

commitMessages.description: Commit messages for the base and head commits.

remove.description: Work-directory paths deleted after this layer is applied (for presence rules whose violation is a missing file).

rename.description: Fixture file or directory to work-directory path, for names that cannot be committed as-is (for example .env or vendor/).

alsoFires.description: Other rule ids the violation fixture is expected to trigger. Any other id in the gate output fails the run.

expect.description: Custom expectations for the violation run.

idPattern.description: JavaScript regular expression the gate output must match instead of the rule id (for tools that print only their own rule name). It must not match an empty output.

relativePath.description: Relative POSIX path: no leading slash, drive letter, backslash, empty segment, or '.'/'..' segment.
